messages:
Taylor: Heads-up: partner sent a batch of sops-encrypted configs using their GCP KMS key. They want us to decrypt+rewrap to our CMEK and store in Vault. Need RBAC + audit plan.
Sam: Prefer partner grants `importer-sa@ourproj` cryptoKeyDecrypt on the exact cryptoKeyVersion. No project-level roles.
Jo: Agree. Add IAM Condition to bind only the specific cryptoKeyVersion if partner's IAM supports it.
Anika: Audit requirements: capture CryptoKeyAccess logs, include operator SA, key version, job id, and hash of plaintext (for integrity). Forward to security BQ.
Taylor: Rewrap flow proposal: partner grants keyDecrypt -> run ephemeral rewrap job in staging -> verify checksums -> store in Vault transit -> destroy plaintext artifacts.
Sam: Make the rewrap job in-memory streaming (no disk). Use ephemeral pods with k8s ephemeral volumes and explicit shred step.
Jo: Include contract clause: partner must give 72h revocation notice if they revoke decrypt binding. If revoked earlier, we must have completed rewraps.
ops-bot: Infra ticket created: infra/rewrap-4521 assigned to Sam. CI pipeline queued. ETA 4h.
Anika: Rotation policy: mark rewrapped secrets with `migrated_from=partner-key:vN` and schedule rotation to our active key within 7 days. Create rotation ticket during post-migration steps.
Taylor: I'll draft PR with terraform snippets, gcloud commands, audit sink steps, and rollback commands. Tagging @Jo and @Anika for review. Will post canary results in this thread.
